cc:Work.dc:title: BPE Tokenization throughput
cc:Work.dc:description: July 2026 geometric mean throughput relative to Hugging Face. Snaptokens and Hugging Face use nested output; Gigatoken uses flat-ragged output. Each workload includes all 156 host-model pairs.
